svg.text: S4 AISLE SHUTTLE — where the empty boxes go
S4 has no nest level: an empty box hangs in its own slot like a full one. Empties go to the lowest slots of their size.

g.text: gallery sets the empty box down

svg.text: What the two faces hold (reference household, doc 4.2)
• An empty box costs a full slot: 26 of 99 slots hold air.
• Empties are fetched least often, so they go to the lowest levels of
their height class (the farthest trip is still only ≈ 6 s).
• Any box fits any slot of its height class or taller; the S / M / T mix
is fixed by the partition set, so S4 has no room left in 650 mm.
Option of the system round (NOT part of S4): nest the empties elsewhere
The lid station keeps the lids; open GN boxes stack inside each other.

g.text: 1 An empty box comes back from the washer. The carriage waits at the top, hook at its rear end
2 The gallery sets the empty box onto the carriage through the roof hatch
3 Down to the lowest free S slot of the front face (the empties’ zone), runners 0.5 mm above
4 The hook pushes the box into the slot (⊗ = away from you), then the carriage drops 5 mm to let go
5 Back to the top. Every empty box takes a slot of its own — S4 has no nest level
